question.text: For an individual investor, tax on Portfolio Manager's performance fees:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Performance fees follow management fees — not deductible by individual in tax computation. **The Trap:** Only business-structure clients may claim differently. **Cross-Exam Context:** XXI-B tax. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Non-deductibility makes high-fee PMS structures tax-inefficient for individuals vs trusts/companies.
